meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过调研、引用和实时反馈提升写作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成高质量文章或内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Improve writing quality with research, citations, and real-time feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce high-quality articles or content efficiently

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会成为你的写作搭档:先帮你列大纲,按需查资料加引用,再逐段审稿、改进开头的钩子,最后整体润色,并保持你的原有语气风格。
howto.when: 当你说要写博客、文章等,或要求“研究主题并加引用”,或请求“改进开头的钩子”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把“AI 对产品管理的影响”列成大纲。
say.note: Claude 会先问清读者、风格等,再生成大纲。

say.text: 研究一下“持续发现”的最新数据,并加引用。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并整理带引用的研究结果。

say.text: 我刚写完“常见错误”一节,请给反馈。
say.note: Claude 会指出优点、改进点和行内修改建议。

howto.what_en: A writing partner that outlines, researches and cites, reviews sections, improves hooks, and polishes the draft—keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write a blog post or article, request research with citations, or ask for hook/feedback help.

say_en.text: Help me outline an article about AI's impact on product management.
say_en.note: Claude asks about audience, style, then builds an outline.

say_en.text: Research the latest data on continuous discovery and add citations.
Here is my 'Common Mistakes' section—please review it.
say_en.note: Claude gives strengths, fixes, and line edits.
